_doc: Sand Creek (ledger 0079 round K): Lake Murray's W1-6 rule (tools/place_signs.py) at the race layout's corners, with Lake Murray's own defaults (tracks/san-diego-lake-murray/signs.json) except include_connectors false: the coordinator's brief puts the arrows at the race layout's corners, not the 106 grid streets' bends. Named in track.config.json signs_file (this port's slug names no tracks/<slug>/).

defaults._doc: see place_signs.DEFAULTS; lateral offsets = curb face 0.08 + raised walk 1.8 (1.5 connector) - 0.25 back-of-walk set-back; height 2.13 m = MUTCD 2A.15 7 ft over a sidewalk; om1_3 = the Type N-1(CA) all-yellow diamond under every arrow (CA MUTCD 2C.10 'should'); kappa_window_m / hysteresis_stations are the corner detector's curvature window and the straight run that ends a corner (place_signs.Ribbon.kappa / walk_to_straight)
defaults._walk_built_only_doc: Sand Creek round 2 (2026-11-23, PC; tools/place_signs.OPT_IN_DEFAULTS, tools/author_signs_blend.mesh_curb_crossing): the mesh stage reads the walk off the BUILT walk meshes alone (CURB / SIDEWALK / 1KERB), never TERRAIN. Measured on 0.2.9 (rehearsal 0209e's loop.blend, the failed-turn ray of SC-D56-fwd): past the dahlia_56th deck's north edge the terrain stands flat at 6.924-6.937 m for 3.25 m (the pad's ground band, deck - 0.045 m), and the old reading took it for a 3.6 m walk: first candidate 3.12 m past the edge (the 3.13 m over the 3.0 m limit of rehearsal 2d26aabc). With the key the ray finds no walk there: the march starts lateral_offset_m (1.63) past the edge and the post's base is the ray-cast terrain (the no-walk rule of ledger 0079 round L). The other posts: SC-48C-rev's walk is the 1KERB strip (unchanged); SC-DAH-fwd's 0.3 m 'walk' was terrain too, its start 30.38 m instead of 29.01 + a 1.35 m march (30.36); the race layout plates and SC-ASH (no walk) do not read one

SC-48C.where: E 48th Ave -> N Colorado Blvd (the S at 48th / Colorado, first turn)
SC-48C._per_layout: ledger 0079 round K, as Lake Murray's M3 / M4 (ledger 0054 A7 / P4): on the BUILT mesh straight on is pavement in Free Roam (a junction pad's deck or a through street; the shared rule finds no clear spot), so the race layout, whose side streets are sealed, gets its own plate behind its sealing wall, in its closure kn5

SC-48S.where: the S at 48th / Colorado, second turn (right), 27 m after SC-48C
SC-48S.reason: both approaches. fwd: a lamp mast stands 2.2 m from the rule's spot (lamps never move, no slide <= 1.0 m clears it); the S's first turn SC-48C carries the plate. rev (ledger 0079 round O, 48th_colorado built): straight on, southbound at x -1515, crosses the pad's measured deck into N Colorado Blvd south, a through street (grid_primary_49 / 52, its two carriageways); the failed-turn ray threads the 6 m between their two ribbons and the rule stood the plate in the middle of the real road (build ro2: verify_signs c_built_edge_clearance). In Free Roam the arrow would point away from a road a driver may take (the module's through-road rule); no race layout drives rev

SC-C50.where: N Colorado Blvd -> E 50th Ave (the colorado_50th pad)

SC-D56.where: Dahlia St -> E 56th Ave (the dahlia_56th pad, unparked 2026-11-22)
SC-D56.note: restored 2026-11-23 (Sand Creek round 2 item 3), fwd only: defaults.walk_built_only. rev stays skipped (its own sub-object, the Mac's call 2026-11-23 after rehearsal 0210's verify_signs FAIL SC-D56-rev c_built_edge_clearance: mesh clearance 1.619 m, the lap's outside-edge polyline 11.12 m away under the pad). 0.2.9 skipped both approaches; the fwd measure is in walk_built_only's doc. The skip's reason, as 0.2.9 had it: both approaches (2026-11-23, PC). fwd (the T's top is Sand Creek's bank): place_signs' polyline stage stands the plate on the failed-turn ray 1.63 m (lateral_offset_m) past the built dahlia_56th deck's north edge, at (-913.928, 1133.297), where the built ground ray-casts 0.51 m under the road's height (6.92 vs 7.44); past GROUND_WARN_M 0.30 the post keeps a walk's analytic base and stands in the air (rehearsal 313fadd3, the spot pinned: verify_signs e_plate_height, f_post_sunk). Unpinned, the mesh stage's march stops 3.13 m from the deck, over the 3.0 m limit (rehearsal 2d26aabc); why its march starts 1.50 m further out is NOT proven (the reading: the pad's ground band past the deck edge taken for a walk). Every spot the rule allows is on the falling bank. In Free Roam the T also turns left onto E 56th west (grid_primary_35), a road the right arrow would point away from. Owed: the mesh stage's march and a post with no built walk under it on falling ground; when that lands, the corner comes back (fwd, the polyline spot above). rev: ledger 0079 round Q build rq1 (dahlia_56th unparked with lm_intake.corner_flare_off, as now): verify_signs FAILED M-c5-rev c_built_edge_clearance, the W1-6L plate at (-941.8, 1107.5). Reversed, the lap comes west on E 56th and turns left onto Dahlia; straight on runs across the pad's measured deck into E 56th west (grid_primary_35, a through street the sign field does not hold: include_connectors false), and the failed-turn rule stood the plate on that street's pavement. As SC-48S rev: no race layout drives rev, and in Free Roam the arrow would point away from a road a driver may take

rev.reason: rev (ledger 0079 round Q build rq1; again rehearsal 0210, 2026-11-23): reversed, the lap comes west on E 56th and turns left onto Dahlia; straight on runs across the dahlia_56th pad's measured deck into E 56th west (grid_primary_35, a through street the sign field does not hold: include_connectors false), and the failed-turn rule stands the plate off that street: verify_signs c_built_edge_clearance (the scan's 1.619 m, but the lap's outside-edge polyline, which the pad replaced here, 11.12 m away). As SC-48S rev: no race layout drives rev, and in Free Roam a left arrow there would point away from a road a driver may take. Owed until the sign field holds grid_primary_35 or the polyline check reads the pad's outline.
